'''Leems''' is an [[Asha'man]] 

==Activities==
Leems is an Asha'man in [[Taim]]'s faction. When [[Androl]] and [[Pevara]] decide to capture [[Dobser]] in the pub cellar, Leems comes in while they are doing it and they are forced to take him out as well. He is given a sedative that keeps him unconscious. His final status is unknown.
